summary: The Student system manages student data, including personal details, consent management, and course enrollments.
purpose: To capture and manage comprehensive student information.

entities.name: Student
entities.description: An entity representing a student with attributes like name, contact information, and enrollment status.

actors.name: Registrar
actors.description: An actor responsible for student data entry and updates.

business_rules: Student consent must be obtained for certain actions.
Student numbers must conform to a specified template.
validations: FirstName, LastName, and StudentNumber are required fields.
conditions: Visibility of certain fields depends on consent status.

dependencies.name: HSPnetSession
dependencies.description: Session details providing context for operations.

exceptions: Cannot display student information if consent is expired.
